title: OpenDebateEvidence: A Massive-Scale Argument Mining and Summarization Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis documenting the overrepresentation of specific philosophical subfields (e.g., Postmodernism, Critical Theory, Feminism) in the dataset, identifying a dominant 'left-wing' bias and the marginalization of 'right-wing' thinkers.

Qualitative assessment of representation bias, noting that the dataset primarily consists of American high school and college debates and may fail to capture the nuances, styles, and diversity of arguments from other cultural, linguistic, or educational contexts.
